status: Separate exploratory reversal design on known periods; not independent validation
hypothesis: A structural break that reclaims its broken level and half of the impulse with opposite local momentum can signal reversal rather than trend continuation.
setup: Same closed confirmedBOS in4h trend and causal running endpoint, minimum2ATR, first50% retracement. At touch or next candle, require opposite directional body, close across midpoint AND reclaim of broken structural level, plus completed5m price/EMA21/slope agreement in reversal direction. Failed break in an uptrend trades short; failed break in downtrend trades long.
entry: Stop one tick beyond reversal candle extreme in reversal direction. Stop beyond same reversal candle opposite extreme plus0.15ATR. Target frozen recovery fraction from original endpoint toward original origin. Stop/target must pass original1.5 cost-adjustednetR gate. No same-bar fills. Pending entries cancel after3bars, stop/target touch, a worse reversal-candle extreme, lost midpoint reclaim, source origin break or original4h trend invalidation. No averaging or extended target beyond origin.
risk: 0.25% equity risk,95% notional,max1BTC,0.07% per-sidecost,2tick slip,0.25ATR sizinggap,actual funding,5m stop-first replay
periods: Same seven already inspected independent accounts2024H1/H2,2025H1/H2,2026Q1/Q2/Q3; no parameter grid or retuning
decision: Report every mode. Experimental Pine candidate only if net>continuation control, >=4 positive periods, positive net excluding best trade and worst period5m closing drawdown<=2xcontrol. Check qualifiers with fee0.10% and20tick slip. Separate script preserves current baseline and must remain labeled exploratory; no unused-validation claim.
